verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management platform that hosts and connects business agents. It is not a coding-agent environment, so whether a coding agent auto-detects and installs toolchains and dependencies is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships this capability: the developer MCP's scaffolding and env-var setting, and the managed isolated sandboxes for deploying apps, are adjacent features, not agent-driven toolchain or dependency installation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
